text: Welcome.
Your mind is still going tonight.
It's been making, solving, and planning all day.
Right now, it's allowed to rest.
Let your eyes close.
Take one slow breath in.
And let it go, long and easy.
Your mind has done so much today.
It's earned a few minutes of nothing.
Notice everything it's still holding onto.
Ideas, plans, things you don't want to forget.
Picture them like tabs, still open in your mind.
One by one, you get to close them now.
Everything will still be there tomorrow.
You can set the list down, just outside the door.
You don't need to figure anything out tonight.
Tomorrow will take care of itself.
Right now, there's just this breath, and this bed.
You've done enough for today.
The morning will hold the rest of it.
